title: FAIR for Hospitals: What a Ransomware Shutdown Really Costs
summary: Liat Hayun, SVP of Product Management at Tenable, explains in HealthTech how exposure management transforms cybersecurity into a "live, defensible metric" under the FAIR framework, enabling hospital CISOs to prioritize budgets around financial and operational impact rather than raw vulnerability counts.
